tables.title: Transfer complete interrupt behavior
tables.text: Table 820, "Transfer complete interrupt behavior", in section 76.8.1 (DMA interrupts) on page 4121. Columns: Interrupt mode, Behavior of TI/RI and eth_sbd_intr_it. 3 data row(s).

rows:
The TI/RI status signals are set whenever the Transfer complete event 
is detected. The bits get cleared whenever the software driver writes 1 
to these bits. The eth_sbd_intr_it is asserted whenever the 
corresponding interrupts are also enabled in ETH_DMACxIER register.

The TI/RI is set as explained above. However, the eth_sbd_intr_it is not 
asserted for any RI/TI events.

The RI/TI status bits are set whenever the Transfer Complete event is 
detected and gets reset whenever software driver clears those bits by 
writing 1. However, if another Transfer Complete event is detected 
before it is cleared (serviced) by the software, these status bits is 
automatically set again. However, the eth_sbd_intr_it is not generated 
based on TI/RI.
